events.text_en: The founder of Trạc Anh Đài takes the frost coast's first whale and weaves his harpoon line from its sinew.
The white whale the coast calls the Old Ivory drags Trạc Anh Đài's founder under off the terrace; his disciple cuts the line, and the boat comes home without him.
